raw.details:
We are excited to announce the CMR HACKFEST 4.0 (36 Hours National Level Hackathon) after the overwhelming success of our previous national-level hackathons. Our previous editions attracted nearly 15,000+ registrations out of which 450+ teams were invited to participate in the offline hackathon, resulting in around 2500+ participants from 23 different states across India.

CMR College of Engineering & Technology (UGC Autonomous Institution), Hyderabad, Telangana is organizing the fourth edition—CMR HACKFEST 4.0 (36 Hours National Level Hackathon), which is set to take place on 08th and 09th January, 2027.

Education, Research and Innovation go hand-in-hand and with the intersection of disciplines, new ideas emerge and impulse innovation. CMRCET is known as the top-notch Institution for its internationally renowned quality in Multidisciplinary Innovation.

CMR HACKFEST 4.0 is an exhilarating and innovative Hackathon that aims to bring together bright minds and creative thinkers from various institutions to collaborate, ideate and innovate in the realm of technology and beyond. It is an excellent opportunity for students to showcase their skills, network with peers and gain valuable experience in problem-solving.

Problem Statements given by Industries under below mentioned themes (Problem Statements are attached herewith this mail)

Themes:

  • HealthTech
  • Agriculture
  • Clean & Green Technology
  • Transportation & Logistics
  • Generative AI
  • Renewable Energy
  • Smart Education
  • Disaster Management
  • Robotics & Drones
  • IOT
  • Open Innovation

 The best Hackathon Projects will receive a Prize pool money upto Rs.2,22,000 and also few Surprise Gifts. Apart from awards, innovative projects have the opportunity to get incubation support, mentorship, industry networking, resources and training. Details of the Cash Prize is as given below

  • The Winner- Rs. 1,00,000/-
  • I Runner-Up- Rs. 60,000/-
  • II Runner-Up - Rs. 25,000/-
  • Three Consolation Prizes- Each Rs. 5,000/-

(One Consolation Prize Exclusively for Girls Team)

  • Theme Based Prizes - Each Rs. 2,000/-

Drive Link for Problem Statements: https://shorturl.at/VU9jp

Shortlisted teams need to pay registration fee: 575/- per person (Includes Accommodation with minimum facilities and food during the event).

Team Size: 3-6 Members

Note: 

  • Initial Round – Idea Submission (Online): Completely free of charge. No registration fee will be collected from participants during this round.
  • Subsequent Round – Offline Hackathon Round: After evaluating the submitted ideas, only shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the offline Round. The shortlisted participants will be required to pay a registration fee of ₹575/- per participant.

Important Deadlines:

Event Dates 08th and 09th January, 2027
Deadline for Registration 25th November, 2026
Acceptance Notification (On or before) 30th November, 2026
· Shortlisted Teams would be informed through mail· Participation Certificate would be given to all the participants

Participation in this CMR HACKFEST 4.0 gives real time exposure to students to work with Industry experts on these specific problems for which these industries are looking for “out of box thinking” or innovative ideas from the students.
